title: No-Show Charges on Room Reservations — Guest Services Tool Card
content:
## Policy

A no-show charge is posted by guest services on a guaranteed Room Reservations reservation the night audit has marked a no-show, once, at the no-show charge amount, recorded under the plan's no-show basis and settled from the money held when the reservation is guaranteed by an advance deposit or a full prepayment, and to the card on file otherwise. A no-show charge is posted only on a reservation whose status is no-show, and a reservation carries at most one cancellation penalty or no-show charge.

| Element | Position | Shown by |
|---|---|---|
| Reservation | marked a no-show by the night audit; status no-show | the reservation record |
| Existing charges | no cancellation penalty or no-show charge already on the reservation | the reservation's charge records |
| Basis recorded | the plan's no-show basis | the plan's penalty basis |
| Settlement | from the money held where the guarantee is an advance deposit or a full prepayment; the card on file otherwise | the guarantee on the reservation record |
| Frequency | once | — |

## Posting the charge: `post_no_show_charge_68d6e4c0`

**Capability.** The tool posts the no-show charge on one room reservation that the hotel's night audit has marked a no-show. One new no-show charge entry is recorded on the reservation for the amount given, dated today, under the basis and settlement given; nothing else on the reservation changes. The guest sees the charge in the reservation's charge history straight away.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: guest services unlocks `post_no_show_charge_68d6e4c0` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `reservation_id` — reference number of the room reservation marked a no-show, as returned by the reservation lookup for the guest's confirmation number (identifier).
- `amount` — amount of the no-show charge, in USD, positive, with 2 decimal places, written as a plain number such as 123.45; stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places.
- `charge_basis` — the basis the charge is recorded under, one of eight values:
  - `first_night_room_and_tax` — when the reservation's plan charges a no-show the first night;
  - `full_stay_room_and_tax` — when the plan charges a no-show the whole stay;
  - `full_prepayment`, `resort_deposit`, `deposit_refund`, `deposit_forfeit`, `deposit_transfer`, `penalty_reversal` — values that never apply to a no-show charge.
- `settlement_source` — where the charge is settled, one of:
  - `card_on_file` — when no money is held for the reservation and the charge goes to the card stored on the profile;
  - `advance_deposit` — when the reservation is guaranteed by money the hotel holds and the charge is settled from it.

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with the keys `charge_id` (reference of the new no-show charge), `reservation_id` (the reservation charged), `amount` (the amount charged, USD with 2 decimal places), `charge_basis` (the basis recorded), `settlement_source` (where it was settled), `posted_date` (the date posted, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, the literal "charged", which shows the charge was recorded.

## Points of judgement

- **Reservation still confirmed the morning after arrival.** The charge is posted only on a reservation whose status is no-show.
- **A second no-show charge.** Not posted; a reservation carries at most one cancellation penalty or no-show charge.
- **Card-guaranteed reservation.** Settled to the card on file.
